_provenance.warning: Harvest windows (days_to_first_harvest), harvest styles and the unsuitable-crop exclusions below were matched on 2026-11-05 against published Kenyan and institutional sources: MOALF-SHEP/JICA crop guides, the FAO sack-gardens factsheet, KALRO, a Kenyan seed-company catalogue, Kenyan container-gardening guides and a peer-reviewed trial. Every citation, verbatim quote and verdict lives in docs/CONTAINER-DATA-SOURCES.md. The min_depth_cm and min_volume_litres values remain app-derived horticultural defaults: no Kenyan official source publishes per-crop container minimums (only kales, corroborated at 30 cm / about 20 L by a Kenyan guide). Do not quote the dimensions as measured trial data.

containers.notes_en: Fastest return of any container leafy green: leaves can start from 21 days when direct-sown; 30-40 is the safe planning window. Sow densely, thin as you harvest.
containers.notes_sw: Mchicha hukua haraka kuliko mboga nyingine za majani: majani yanaweza kuanza kupatikana siku 21 ukipanda mbegu moja kwa moja; siku 30-40 ni makadirio salama. Panda kwa karibu, una kadiri unavyovuna.

containers.notes_en: One plant feeds a household for months if outer leaves are picked and the crown is left. Weekly cuts keep it producing.
containers.notes_sw: Mmea mmoja unaweza kutosha familia kwa miezi ukichukua majani ya nje na kuacha kiini. Kuvuna kila wiki kunaendeleza mavuno.

containers.notes_en: Needs full sun, staking and consistent water. Pick ripe fruit regularly: most varieties keep cropping over 3-4 months; early types can start at 60 days from transplanting.
containers.notes_sw: Inahitaji jua kamili, kufungwa kamba na maji ya mara kwa mara. Vuna matunda yaliyoiva mara kwa mara: aina nyingi huendelea kuzaa miezi 3-4; aina za mapema zinaweza kuanza siku 60 baada ya kupandikizwa.

containers.notes_en: Tolerates dry conditions and poor media better than most. Green pods from about 9-11 weeks; the leaves are also edible and ready in 3-4 weeks.
containers.notes_sw: Inastahimili ukame na udongo mbaya kuliko nyingi. Makonde mabichi kuanzia wiki 9-11; majani pia huliwa na yapo tayari wiki 3-4.

containers.notes_en: A climber. Give it a balcony railing or string; green pods from about 11-14 weeks, and continued picking keeps the crop coming.
containers.notes_sw: Ni mpanda juu. Ipe kizingiti cha roshani au kamba; makonde mabichi kuanzia wiki 11-14, na kuendelea kuvuna kunakuza mavuno.

containers.notes_en: Grown in a container for leaves from about 8 weeks; tubers need a deep sack (90 kg grain sacks are the Kenyan standard) and 4-7 months.
containers.notes_sw: Hupandwa kwenye chombo kwa ajili ya majani kuanzia wiki 8; viazi vinahitaji gunia kirefu (magunia ya nafaka ya kilo 90 ndiyo ya kawaida Kenya) na miezi 4-7.
